edit: her horns are redrawn, and ONLY the horns. KEEP THE HEAD SHAPE EXACTLY AS IN IMAGE 1: the top of the head stays round and full, the black hair keeps its volume and lifts in a soft rounded mass over the crown, nothing flattens or presses down the top of the head. The horns: a pair of slender horns, black at the root and turning dark red toward the polished bright tips. Each grows out of the hair at the side of the head, just above the temple and a little behind the hairline, NOT from the top of the head and NOT straight out sideways. From there each horn rises a little and then sweeps BACKWARD, following the curve of the skull close to the head, the tip pointing back behind the head and slightly up. Both horns are drawn, one on each side, the same size; they sit below the highest point of the crown so the round top of the head is still the outline. A small dim red flame flickers along each horn and at its tip, lighting the nearby black hair faintly red. Everything else stays exactly as in Image 1: the same face, expression, eyes, hair, hairstyle, hair colour and hair volume, the same clothes, hands, held items and pose.
